[ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Texas court reduces $50M judgment against Infowars' Alex Jones over falsely labeling Newtown killings a hoax
item.description: A Texas court on Friday slashed a $50 million judgment that Alex Jones was ordered to pay families of the 2012 Sandy Hook Elementary School massacre. The new judgement is about $6 million.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] A sell-off in the bond market could make it more expensive to buy a car or use a credit card
item.description: This week, the U.S. Treasury announced a plan to buy more bonds. It's having a direct impact on the economy and your wallet.
